entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

This application has been moved with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.1303 of 2019 (Sonvati VS. Pervendra and others), under Sections 498-A, 323, 506, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 DP Act, Police Station Chhatari, District Buland Shahar including the impugned summoning order dated 16.03.2020 pending before the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Buland Shahar and also quash to revisional order dated 01.09.2022 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, Court No.3, Buland Shahar in Criminal Revision No.71 of 2022 (Jogendra Vs. State of UP and another).

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the parties submitted that parties settled the matter by way of compromise, a copy of the report of verified compromise deed as well as that of verification order has been placed before the Court, hence proceedings and impugned order are liable to be quashed.

The attention of this Court has been drawn to the following judgements of the Apex Court:-
1. B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another (2003) 4 SCC 675.

5. Narindra Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab, (2014) 6 SCC 466.

sentences.text: In the aforesaid cases, the Apex Court has categorically held that compromise can be made between the parties even in respect of certain cognizable and non compoundable offences.

Reference may also be made to the decision given by this Court in Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. and another, 2013 (83) ACC 278 in which the law expounded by the Apex court in the aforesaid cases has been explained in detail.

entities.text: Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. and another, 2013 (83) ACC 278
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as noted herein above, and also the submissions made by the counsel for the parties, the court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose would be served by prolonging the proceedings of the above mentioned cases.
In view of the above, the proceedings of the aforesaid case are hereby, quashed.
